name: Chez Leon
address: 500 N Florida Ave, Tampa, FL 33602, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Alex Dankic
reviewSamples.text: I had no idea what a croque monsieur was before I came here but once I had it here I’ve been absolutely addicted. I can’t go for more than a week without stopping by and getting one for the past couple of months. Amazing other food options as well as service! I can’t recommend this place enough.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of T-REX
reviewSamples.text: Yep, that was good.  Got the beef bourguignon with potatoes and that might be the best meal I've had in downtown Tampa!  Buddy got the Croquet Monsieur and he really liked it.  Mostly been disappointed with food trucks in Tampa but this one bucks the trend.  Try them out!  I'll be back
